div.head: IX Atr 1
div.ab: An ærest þæt ƿe ealle to Gode ælmihtigan georne gebugan ⁊ his bebodu healdan and unrihtes ealle gesƿican . . . . [Expl.] An uton ænne God lufian and ƿeorðian and ænne Cristendom ealle healde ⁊ ælcne hæþendom mid ealle aƿeorpan. Uton ænne cynehlaford holdliche . . . .

An ærest, þæt we ealle to Gode ælmihtigan georne gebugan ⁊ his bebodu healdan ⁊ unrihtes ealle geswican. (Expl.) An[d] uton ænne God lufian and weorðian and ænne Cristendom ealle heald[an] ⁊ ælcne hæþendom mid ealle aweorpan. Uton ænne cynehlaford holdliche…(desunt reliqua.)

An ærest þæt þe ealle to Gode ælmihtigan georne gebugan and his bebodu healdan and unrihtes ealle geswican. . . . Exp And uton ænne God lufian and weorðian and ænne Cristendom ealle healdan and ælcne hæþendom mid ealle aweorpan. Uton ænne cynehlaford holdliche. . . .

Erstens, dass wir alle uns vor Gott dem Allmächtigen ernstlich beugen und seine Gebote halten und von Unrecht alle ablassen . . . . . . . . . Explicit. Und lasst uns Einen Gott lieben und ehren und Ein Christenthum alle festhalten und jedes Heidenthum gänzlich verwerfen. Lasst uns Einen königlichen Herrn treulich . . . .

First, that we all bow eagerly before God Almighty and keep his commandments and all desist from wrongdoing . . . . (Explicit:) And let us love and honour one God and all hold one Christian faith and utterly reject all heathenism. Let us loyally [hold to] one royal lord . . . .

In the first place, we shall all zealously turn to God Almighty and keep his commandments and all cease from evil…. And let us love and honour one God and all uphold one Christian faith and utterly renounce all heathen practices. Let us loyally [support] one royal lord….

First, that we all willingly submit to almighty God and observe his commandments and wholly reject injustice. . . . Exp And let us love and praise the one God and keep to the one Christian faith and wholly repudiate every heathen practice. Let us faithfully support one royal lord. . . .
div.note: Wanley gives only the beginning and the end (‘Explicit’: ‘An uton ænne God lufian and weorðian and ænne Cristendom ealle healde ⁊ ælcne hæþendom mid ealle aweorpan. Uton ænne cynehlaford holdliche . . . .’, Liebermann correcting ‘An’ to ‘And’, ‘healde’ to ‘healdan’, ‘holdliche’ to ‘holdlice’); the rest is lost. The Explicit has no row of its own in this sheet, so its German and English are given here. Liebermann compares V Atr 1, 34 f.; VI Atr 42.1 f.; AY: added from Rabin p. 206 / 207, October 2026 (Rabin’s note to the text); AJ: corrected against Gesetze I p. 269 (column heading “Hs. Cotton Otho A X”), October 2026 (was “Wanley”, now “Otho A.x”); AN: corrected against Gesetze I p. 269 (column heading “Hs. Cotton Otho A X”), October 2026 (was “Wanley”, now “Otho A.x”); G: corrected against Gesetze I p. 269 (column heading “Hs. Cotton Otho A X”), October 2026 (was “Thesaurus Linguarum Septentrionalium”, now “Otho A.x”)
holdliche: Liebermann recommends emending to holdlice, though holdliche is a legitimate late form of the word
